content: औशन, औशनस {%a.%} (-नी, -सी|{%f.%}) [उशनस्-अण्] Belonging or peculiar to Uśanas; originating from Uśanas, or taught by him; पितामहाद्वरं लेभे सर्वमौशनसं धनम् <ls>Rām. 4. 51. 13</ls>. .{@-सम्@} .²1 The law-book of उशनस् (a treatise on civil polity). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of an Upapurāṇa. .{@-साः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a school of writers on the science of government mentioned by Kauṭilya; <ls>Kau. A. 1. 15</ls>. .{@-सी@} <ab>N.</ab> of Devayanī; तं वीरमाहौशनसी प्रेमनिर्भरया गिरा <ls>Bhāg. 9. 18. 20</ls>.
